answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through velvet credentials: each identity is minted by staking utility tokens and collecting time-locked attestations from a randomized quorum of existing agents. Attestation weights ripple outward across a trust graph, decaying for inactive or malicious nodes. An attacker must fund a comet swarm of bonded, endorsed identities and bear ongoing capital burn and slashing losses with no guaranteed return.
